listing.aiSummary: Adds new ships, weapons, and missions with basic campaign integration.

description:
Warning! Warning! F.N.G inbound, take evasive manoeuvres and standby..

Standby!
Warning! Unknown space hulks detected.. Scanning..
...
Affirmative, 2 hulks detected - One known, designated: Onslaught (Friendly loss, KIA) Second: Unknown, standby...
Threat - Unknown - Recommended course of action?
...
Send the 3rd armada.
...
Understood, re-routing the 3rd armada to intercept.. E.T.A. 2 minutes. Out.

Sir, there's something else out there.. Something.. Unknown.

Reinforcements are en-route!

Download 0.5!
http://www.mediafire.com/?3zv56rgumlxly6t

IMPORTANT!
-
Basic Campaign integration!
-
Be very careful when deploying the cruisers and above for any new ship, they tend to collide while coming onto the battlefield and bad things happen, especially with the Halcyon and Spirit of Fire!
-
Some sprites were created pixel by pixel, and some with the BSF ship maker!

-Update Log-
